verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers' V8 isolate model explicitly eliminates cold starts and manages global scaling automatically per-request without server provisioning, backed by vendor docs and echoed by community reports of instant, fast deployment ('easy to use and very quick', 'API running in production in an hour'). Some caveats exist around CPU-time limits for long-running tasks, but the core boot-speed/scale story is well supported.
